name: facebook_games_sdk
summary: Facebook Games SDK REST connector scoped to https://developers.facebook.com/docs/games/. Covers Login (debug_token), App Events (send_app_event), Instant Games (register_instant_game, leaderboard_get, notification_send), and limited Graph (graph_get_me, app_secret_proof_compute). Stdlib-only (no `facebook-sdk` python package). Auth model: app access token computed via /oauth/access_token client_credentials grant (cached for the lifetime of the connector instance), with `<app_id>|<app_secret>` fallback. User-context endpoints require FB_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN; appsecret_proof auto-attached to /me when both app secret + user token are present. Every successful HTTP call appends one InferenceRecord with tier='social_event', model='facebook_games', scope=f'fb_<tool>'. Graceful degrade: missing FB_APP_ID + FB_APP_SECRET → connect() returns False and every send() returns SendResult(success=False, error='facebook_games_keys not configured') without making any network requests.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring stripe_mcp + deepseek_mcp shape exactly. SERVICE='facebook_games'. Form-encoded urllib POSTs to graph.facebook.com/<version>/* for write endpoints, GETs for reads. Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args). connect() probes /oauth/access_token grant_type=client_credentials and caches the app token. app_secret_proof_compute is purely local (hmac/hashlib) and bypasses the connect gate, returning a graceful 'missing FB_APP_SECRET' error if the secret is absent.

env_vars.FB_APP_ID: Facebook App ID (developers.facebook.com/apps → App Settings → Basic)
env_vars.FB_APP_SECRET: Facebook App Secret (same dashboard; treat as bearer-equivalent)
env_vars.FB_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN: Optional user-OAuth token for /me + appsecret_proof flows
env_vars.FB_GRAPH_API_BASE: Full base URL override (skips version composition)

user_provisioning_required.rationale: FB_APP_ID and FB_APP_SECRET are user-issued credentials tied to a Meta developer account. They are NOT included in the shared .env today. Until Tom provisions them the connector will graceful-fail every send() call without making any network requests.
how_to_obtain: 1. Visit https://developers.facebook.com/apps and create or select an App.
2. From the App Dashboard → Settings → Basic, copy 'App ID' → FB_APP_ID.
3. From the same panel, click 'Show' on 'App Secret' → FB_APP_SECRET.

4. For FB_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN: use the Graph API Explorer (https://developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer/) — select your app, generate a User Access Token with the scopes you need (e.g. 'public_profile', 'email', 'user_friends', or 'gaming_user_picture' / 'gaming_profile' for Instant Games).
5. To register an Instant Game or send notifications, Meta requires the app to pass App Review for the relevant permissions; 4xx from register_instant_game is expected until review completes.

convenience_wrappers: verify_credentials()  — read-only smoke; fetches app token then GET /<app_id>?fields=name,namespace,category
send_app_event(event_name, custom_data={}, event_id='')  — POST /<app_id>/activities with CUSTOM_APP_EVENTS shape
register_instant_game(name, category, namespace, asset_urls)  — POST /<app_id>/instant_games (likely needs Meta review → 4xx documented as expected)
app_secret_proof_compute(user_access_token)  — local HMAC SHA-256; no HTTP, no connect required

routing_connections.substrate_reads: FB_APP_ID + FB_APP_SECRET + FB_USER_ACCESS_TOKEN + FB_GRAPH_API_VERSION + FB_GRAPH_API_BASE via studio/auth/keys.load_env
routing_connections.substrate_writes: send_log entries + crystal_chain social_event records (only when keys present + call succeeds)

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.connect: expected_false — FB_APP_ID + FB_APP_SECRET absent from .env (user provisioning pending)
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.no_network_calls: verified — every send() returns the graceful error before any urllib request when keys are absent

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every successful HTTP tool call has a deterministic InferenceRecord with tier='social_event', model='facebook_games', scope='fb_<tool>'
Stdlib-only — no `facebook-sdk` or `requests` package required; uses urllib (form-encoded POST + GET)
Graceful — missing FB_APP_ID/FB_APP_SECRET → connect() returns False and send() returns SendResult(success=False, error='facebook_games_keys not configured') WITHOUT any network call
Redacted logs — access_token, input_token, user_access_token, appsecret_proof, app_secret are stripped from the crystal-anchor payload
appsecret_proof local — app_secret_proof_compute is a pure HMAC SHA-256 computation; no HTTP, available even without a working connect
Auto-proof — graph_get_me auto-appends appsecret_proof when both FB_APP_SECRET and a user token are available (FB server-call best practice)
Versioned — FB_GRAPH_API_VERSION env-controlled (default v18.0); FB_GRAPH_API_BASE for full overrides
usage_example:
from core.lib.third_party.facebook_games_sdk import FacebookGamesSDKConnector
c = FacebookGamesSDKConnector()
if c.connect():
    r = c.send('verify_credentials', '')
    print(r.metadata.get('name'), r.crystal_id)
    r2 = c.send('send_app_event', json.dumps({'event_name':'level_completed','custom_data':{'level':3,'score':1250}}))
    print(r2.success, r2.crystal_id)
else:
    print('no FB_APP_ID/FB_APP_SECRET — set in .env to enable')
